target: tracker.sh advance — Guard A, gated statuses are unreachable without their bookkeeping
cmd:
mkdir -p factory/specs; printf -- '---
id: 001
title: thing
status: built
---
body
' > factory/specs/001-a.md; source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh"; if ( tracker_advance factory/specs/001-a.md shelved ) >/dev/null 2>&1; then A=0; else A=$?; fi; if ( tracker_advance factory/specs/001-a.md superseded ) >/dev/null 2>&1; then B=0; else B=$?; fi; if ( tracker_claim built shelved loop ) >/dev/null 2>&1; then C=0; else C=$?; fi; jq -n --argjson a "$A" --argjson b "$B" --argjson c "$C" --arg st "$(_tracker_field factory/specs/001-a.md status)" --arg from "$(_tracker_field factory/specs/001-a.md shelved_from)" '{a: $a, b: $b, c: $c, st: $st, from: $from}'
_note: the bypass hole: `advance <file> shelved` writes the status with no shelved_from, producing a spec that can never be restored — silently. Both advance and claim must refuse, since either could reach the status otherwise.
